description: Show a node through its index: the notes agents keep about what is under it (KEY<TAB>description). It is a view, not the facts: entries can be missing or stale; for the real contents use ls or json_ls. First line "[index] WHERE, N entries" names the index file read; to change an index, edit that place with json_set / json_add / json_del. A key joins back to a path as DIR/KEY (folder) or FILE#/KEY, FILE#/POINTER/KEY (json). Example: {"path": "knowledge/aos", "key": "tools"}.

path.description: the node to look at: a folder, FILE, or FILE#/POINTER (written like the json tools); shows the index at its natural place. Relative paths start at your workspace.

index.description: one index table to read (FILE or FILE#/POINTER, pointing at the table itself), e.g. your own view. Alone: only this one. With path: laid over the natural index, its entries win on the same key.

key.description: show only this entry (the key exactly as written in the index, no patterns)

offset.description: start at this entry (for the next page)

limit.description: at most this many entries (default: env AOS_JSON_MAX_ITEMS, else 200)
